d: Bihar ki dulari devi ko mithila penting me padmashri mila hai.machhuaara samuday se aane vali dulari ko mila ye samman mahatvapurn hai. dulari bihar ke madhubni ke ranti ganv ki hai. unhen pyar se ganv vale 'dula' kahte hai. ranti se padmashri pane vali dulari tisri mahila hai. isse pahle ganv ki mahasundri devi aur godavri datta ko padmashri mil chuka hai. bihar se mithila kala me ye satvan padm puruskar hai. 12 sal ki umr me dulari ki jagdev mukhiya se shadi huee lekin 6 mahine ki apni beti ki maut aur sasural valon ke tanon se pareshan dulari do sal me hi ranti vapas laut aayi. unhonne…
